mentions.name: TripTruth
mentions.description: Travel itinerary app that uses LLMs to read booking confirmation details, including cancellation minutiae, and turns them into a simple timeline for travel tracking and itinerary sharing. Positioned as a modern alternative to TripIt's long-stagnant parsing.
mentions.problem: Existing travel/itinerary tools like TripIt haven't updated their parsing in ~15 years, leaving travelers without modern extraction of booking details such as cancellation terms into a shareable timeline.
mentions.audience: Consumers/travelers who still rely on legacy itinerary tools like TripIt for travel tracking and itinerary sharing.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://triptruth.app

All the travel apps out there are built for the instagram generation but dinosaurs like me still use TripIt for travel tracking and itinerary sharing. But its parsing hasn’t changed since Concur bought it 15 years (!) ago and I thought it would be nice to have LLMs read the cancellation minutiae for trips and put in a simple timeline for sharing.
